name: koda-code-vscode
description: Run Koda V4's adaptive, evidence-backed engineering workflow from VS Code.

scripts.check: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run lint && npm test

koda.enginePath.description: Optional path to a trusted Koda 0.4+ executable. Relative paths are resolved from the selected workspace.

koda.engineTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time for one Koda engine invocation.

languageModelTools.name: koda-code_project
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect a workspace repository and list its authoritative Koda V4 mission states, engineering profile, and adaptive quality contract. Read-only. Use before beginning or resuming a mission.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Inspect the selected project and its Koda missions

repository.description: Workspace folder or nested repository path. Required when multiple workspace folders are open.

languageModelTools.name: koda-code_begin
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create one authoritative Koda V4 mission, engineering profile, adaptive quality contract, and isolated Git worktree. Mutates only Koda state and the new worktree/branch; never installs software or pushes.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create an isolated Koda engineering mission

repository.description: Workspace folder or nested repository path.

languageModelTools.name: koda-code_answer
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Record the user's answer to the next authoritative product-language question for a mission. Rejects answers when no question is pending.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Record the user's next Koda clarification

languageModelTools.name: koda-code_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read authoritative V4 mission stages, remediation count, next specialist, deterministic checks, engineering profile, adaptive capability states, stale-evidence state, and ready-to-finish eligibility. Read-only; unknown and unavailable are not passes.

languageModelTools.name: koda-code_evidence
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read bounded Git diff, changed paths, branch, head, staging state, fingerprints, and quality results for a mission worktree. Read-only.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read bounded evidence from a Koda mission worktree

languageModelTools.name: koda-code_record
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Record one assigned specialist result only after the Python engine validates current Git and quality evidence. Read-only roles require the prior evidence fingerprint. Controls bounded remediation state.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Record a specialist result with deterministic evidence

languageModelTools.name: koda-code_check
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Re-resolve stale V4 engineering evidence, then run only deterministic argv-based checks configured in koda-code.toml inside the mission worktree. Detects check-caused Git changes. Never uses a shell; unavailable verification is not a pass.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run the project's deterministic Koda quality gate
